$comment: Source of truth for window.browserAPI. Edit HERE, then run npm run browser-api:build. See browser-api/README.md.

TabId.doc: Opaque tab id minted by main (a UUID today).

GroupId.doc: Opaque tab group id minted by main.

PermissionPromptId.doc: Id of a pending permission prompt: a per-process counter in main.

CaptureSurfaceId.doc: Id of a capturing surface: a TabId for a tab, or `popup:<webContentsId>` for an auxiliary popup.

DisplayShareId.doc: Id of an active screen share (`share-<n>`), minted by the display-capture registry.

ConnectionState.doc: Connection claim for a committed URL. null in a payload means no claim (loading, or not HTTP).

TabLayout.doc: Tab presentation; main ignores other values.

CreateTabOptions.doc: Options for a new tab. Only `private` is read by main today.

OpenWorkspaceOptions.doc: Options for opening or creating a workspace.

decision.doc: The token from an unsaved-scratch result, confirming "discard and switch".

newWindow.doc: Open in a new window instead of this one.

PermissionPromptPayload.doc: A pending permission prompt, built by the permission prompter in main.js.

permission.doc: Electron permission name, such as media or geolocation.

mediaTypes.doc: Requested media types, per the prompter JSDoc in permissions.js.

ShieldChip.doc: Shield chip state, derived by shieldChipState() in shield-model.js.

CertificateSummary.doc: Certificate fields sanitized by sanitizeCertificate() in site-security.js.

SiteInfo.doc: Page-info model, built by buildSiteInfo() in site-security.js.

error.doc: Present only when state is certificate-error.

TabEntry.doc: One tab in tabs:updated, projected by serializeTabs() in main.js. Main-only state never crosses this projection.

favicon.doc: A data:image/png;base64 URL, or null. Always null for private tabs.

bookmarked.doc: Whether the page is a Favorite.

audible.doc: Playing sound that can reach the speakers.

fillHint.doc: A login form is present (structure only).

excepted.doc: Ads are allowed on this site.

TabGroup.doc: A tab group. Groups have names, not colors.

ClosedEntrySummary.doc: A closed entry as renderers see it, projected by projectEntries() in closed-tabs.js.

ShieldProviderControls.doc: Blocking provider controls, from shieldProviderModel() in shield-model.js.

ShieldPopover.doc: The active tab's shield popover: shieldPopoverModel() plus provider controls.

CaptureRow.doc: One capturing surface in the capture popover.

DisplayShareSummary.doc: A screen share, projected by projectDisplayShares() in display-capture-indicator.js.

TabsSnapshot.doc: Result of getAllTabs, built by the tabs:get-all handler in main.js.

TabsUpdatedPayload.doc: The tabs:updated broadcast, built by currentTabsPayload() in main.js.

ShieldAnchorUpdate.doc: Where the shield popover's arrow sits, sent by syncShieldAnchor() in main.js.

x.doc: Horizontal position in the overlay's own coordinates.

connected.doc: Whether the popover is anchored to a known chip.

VerticalTabsMetrics.doc: Vertical tab rail widths, from verticalTabsMetrics() in main.js.

GlanceLayout.doc: Glance split geometry, from calculateGlanceLayout() in glance-layout.js.

glance.doc: Alias of glanceContent kept for older consumers.

WorkspaceSaveStatus.doc: Named Workspaces storage status, from workspaces.js.

DeletedWorkspace.doc: A recently deleted workspace that can still be restored.

WorkspacesPayload.doc: Named Workspaces projection, from workspacesProjection() in main.js.

ThemeAppearance.doc: The chrome's effective appearance; pending while a system theme is still resolving.

DarkSiteResult.doc: The outcome of /dark-site. `darkened` describes the site while Blanc is dark; in a private tab the choice lasts until Blanc quits.

PageTint.doc: A tab's sampled page color, sent as a color-only update.

DownloadsActivity.doc: Download activity for the strip, from downloadsActivity() in downloads.js.

OverlayMode.doc: Overlay modes; every showOverlay() call in main.js passes one of these literals.

ShieldTrigger.doc: Which strip control opened the shield popover.

RestoreTrigger.doc: The strip control that should regain focus when the overlay closes.

OverlayShowPayload.doc: Sent when main shows the overlay.

purpose.doc: Mode-specific: a string for Glance, an object for panel flows, a model for screen sharing.

pillRect.doc: The resting pill in the overlay's coordinates; absent when replayed after the overlay loads.

OverlayHidePayload.doc: Sent when main hides the overlay.

retract.doc: Animate the panel back into the pill.

IslandState.doc: Island presentation state for the strip.

restoreTrigger.doc: Present only when the overlay closes.

FindResult.doc: Find-in-page counts for the active tab, sent from tab-view.js.

WorkspaceErrorCode.doc: Every error code a Named Workspace action can report, from workspace-controller.js, workspaces.js, workspaces-model.js and the workspace functions in main.js.

WorkspaceProtectionReason.doc: Why a window may not switch workspaces right now, from workspaceProtection() in main.js.

WorkspaceAction.doc: What a successful open or create did: swapped this window, found it already here, or focused another window.

WorkspaceActionResult.doc: Result of every Named Workspace action. Successes carry the refreshed workspace list; failures carry an error code and, for some codes, extra detail.

cause.doc: Why a saved workspace could not be opened (with saved-not-opened).

decision.doc: Token to send back as a confirmed "discard and switch" (with unsaved-scratch).

windowId.doc: The window that now shows the workspace (with action focus).

workspaceId.doc: The new workspace, after a create or save, including a save that could not be opened.

SearchEngineId.doc: A search engine id. Must match the searchEngines ids in settings-schema/schema.json.

HistoryEntry.doc: A history entry, from listHistory() in history.js: the stored visit plus the site's cached favicon.

title.doc: The page title, or the URL when the page had none.

visitedAt.doc: Epoch milliseconds of the latest visit.

favicon.doc: A sanitized PNG data URL, or null.

FavoriteItem.doc: A Favorite, from listBookmarks() in bookmarks.js. Internally still called a bookmark.

title.doc: The page title, or the URL when the page had none.

favicon.doc: A sanitized PNG data URL, or null. Items saved by older versions may lack it.

updatedAt.doc: Epoch milliseconds of the last synced edit. Items saved by older versions may lack it.

folder.doc: The folder name, or null when ungrouped. Items saved by older versions may lack it.

RemoteTab.doc: Another device's open tab, sanitized by tabsync-model.js, with its synced icon attached by tabicons-model.js.

favicon.doc: A sanitized PNG data URL, or null.

RemoteGroup.doc: A tab group on another device.

RemoteDevice.doc: Another device's open tabs, from displayDevices() in tabsync-model.js. Newest first; devices without tabs or older than the prune window are left out.

SearchSuggestions.doc: Search suggestions for the address bar, labelled with the engine that produced them.

suggestions.doc: Empty when suggestions are off, the tab is private, or the query is ineligible.

ProviderBlockAdsResult.doc: uBlock Origin handled the block-ads command; its state arrives with the next tabs:updated.

BlockAdsResult.doc: What Blanc Blocker did for the block-ads command, from resolveBlockAdsCommand() in adblock-exceptions.js.

action.doc: unexcept: the active site left the allow-list and blocking is on. toggle: blocking was switched.

hostname.doc: The site removed from the allow-list, or null for a toggle.

AllowAdsError.doc: Why ads could not be allowed on the active site. Settings opens on its blocking section.

FillLoginFailure.doc: A 1Password fill that did not fill, from credential-fill-controller.js. The user has already been told why.

reason.doc: A flow reason such as 'cancelled' or 'no-match', or a broker/SDK error code.

FillLoginSuccess.doc: A 1Password fill that filled at least one field. No credential data is returned.

IslandRectReport.doc: The resting pill's rectangle as the strip reports it, plus the open shield popover's anchor.

shieldAnchor.doc: Present while the shield popover is open, so a uBlock Origin popup can follow the pill.

ShieldAnchor.doc: Where the shield popover opens, from the strip control that opened it. Main validates the coordinates against the window.

FindInPageOptions.doc: Options for findInPage, passed to Electron's webContents.findInPage unchanged. Must name the same fields as Electron's FindInPageOptions.

findNext.doc: Start a new find session (default false).

HistoryListOptions.doc: Filters for listHistory, read by listHistory() in history.js.

query.doc: Case-insensitive substring of the URL or title.

DisplayPickerChoice.doc: The overlay's answer to the screen-share picker, read by display-capture-picker.js. Main ignores it unless the sender owns that live request.

sourceId.doc: The chosen source. Ignored on Linux, where the system portal chooses.

computerAudioApproved.doc: Only honored when the page asked for audio.

cancelled.doc: true cancels the request. The overlay cancels through closeOverlay instead.

members.name: platform
members.doc: The host OS as Electron's sandboxed process reports it.

members.name: createTab
members.doc: Open a new tab. A plain new tab is always ungrouped. Resolves to the new tab id.

members.name: closeTab
members.doc: Close a tab and record a closed entry.

members.name: reopenClosedTab
members.doc: Reopen the most recent closed entry in this window.

members.name: reopenClosedEntry
members.doc: Reopen a specific closed entry.

members.name: forgetClosedEntry
members.doc: Forget one closed entry and destroy any parked view.

members.name: clearClosedEntries
members.doc: Forget every closed entry in this window.

members.name: switchTab
members.doc: Activate a tab.

members.name: navigate
members.doc: Navigate a tab to typed input; main normalizes it. Resolves to undefined when nothing loads in the tab itself (unknown tab, an OS hand-off, a utility page, or a quiet tab, which wakes in the background); otherwise to whether the queued load ran and finished (false when superseded or failed).

members.name: search

params.name: engine
params.doc: Ignored by main; the engine comes from Settings.

members.doc: Search for a query in a tab with the engine from Settings. Resolves to undefined for an empty query, an unknown tab or a started load, and to whether a quiet tab woke. Under the desktop test hook only, it resolves to the search URL instead of loading it.

members.name: goBack
members.doc: Go back in a tab. Resolves to whether a quiet tab woke, otherwise to undefined.

members.name: goForward
members.doc: Go forward in a tab. Resolves to whether a quiet tab woke, otherwise to undefined.

members.name: reload
members.doc: Reload a tab. Resolves to whether a quiet tab woke, otherwise to undefined.

members.name: stop
members.doc: Stop loading a tab. Resolves to the Electron WebContents method's undefined result.

members.name: reorderTab
members.doc: Move a tab to an index in the tab order.

members.name: reorderTabWithinBucket
members.doc: Move a tab before another within its pinned/group bucket.

members.name: activateTabFromRail
members.doc: Activate a tab from the vertical tab rail.

members.name: setGlanceTab
members.doc: Show a tab as the Glance side view.

members.name: openGlancePicker
members.doc: Open the Glance tab picker.

members.name: closeGlance
members.doc: Close the Glance view.

members.name: promoteGlance
members.doc: Promote the Glance tab to the active tab. Resolves to whether the Glance tab became the active tab.

members.name: setTabGroup
members.doc: Move a tab into a group, or out of all groups with null.

members.name: groupTabByName
members.doc: Find or create a named group and move the tab into it.

members.name: toggleGroupCollapsed
members.doc: Fold or unfold a group in the panel.

members.name: focusGroup
members.doc: Activate a group's first tab, unfolding it.

members.name: closeGroup
members.doc: Close every tab in a group as one closed entry.

members.name: toggleBookmark
members.doc: Toggle Favorite for the active tab.

members.name: saveFavorite

params.name: folder
params.doc: A folder name, or null for no folder. Main trims and validates it.

members.doc: Save the active tab as a Favorite in a folder.

members.name: toggleTabPinned
members.doc: Pin or unpin a tab. Resolves to the new pinned state, or false when the tab is unknown.

members.name: toggleTabMuted
members.doc: Mute or unmute a tab. Resolves to the new muted state, or false when the tab is unknown.

members.name: duplicateTab
members.doc: Duplicate a tab. Resolves to the duplicate's id, or undefined when the tab is unknown.

members.name: openPage
members.doc: Open an internal page (utility pages open in the sheet).

members.name: getAllTabs
members.doc: Read the current tab list on demand.

members.name: findInPage
members.doc: Find text in a page. Resolves to Electron's find request id, to whether a quiet tab woke (find again once it has), or to undefined for an unknown tab. Counts arrive through onFindResult.

members.name: stopFindInPage
members.doc: Stop find-in-page. Resolves to the Electron WebContents method's undefined result.

members.name: respondPermission
members.doc: Answer a pending permission prompt.

members.name: onPermissionPrompt
members.doc: A permission prompt is pending.

members.name: reportChromeLayout
members.doc: Report the strip height so main can lay out tab views.

members.name: reportIslandRect
members.doc: Report the resting pill's rectangle.

members.name: onShieldAnchor
members.doc: Where the shield popover should anchor.

members.name: onIslandProximity
members.doc: Pointer proximity to the island, sent only when it changes (0 beyond range).

members.name: setTabLayout
members.doc: Switch between island and vertical tabs; returns the layout now in effect.

members.name: previewVerticalTabsWidth
members.doc: Preview a vertical tab rail width while dragging.

members.name: setVerticalTabsWidth
members.doc: Commit a vertical tab rail width. Resolves to the width actually committed.

members.name: onVerticalTabsWidth
members.doc: Vertical tab rail metrics changed.

members.name: resizeGlance
members.doc: Resize the Glance view to a pointer position.

members.name: resetGlance
members.doc: Reset the Glance view size. Resolves to the reset ratio, or null when no Glance is open.

members.name: onGlanceLayout
members.doc: Glance layout changed.

members.name: onGlanceStatus
members.doc: A Glance status message for the chrome to show.

members.name: openIsland
members.doc: Expand the island panel.

members.name: openIslandCommands
members.doc: Expand the island panel in slash-command mode.

members.name: openIslandTyping
members.doc: Expand the island panel, seeding the input with a typed character.

members.name: openFindBar
members.doc: Open the find capsule.

members.name: openShieldPopover
members.doc: Open the site-protection popover.

members.name: selectBlockingProvider
members.doc: Choose the blocking provider from the shield popover. Resolves to false when refused; on a restart, to whether the restart went ahead.

members.name: openBlockingPopup
members.doc: Open the active blocking provider's popup.

members.name: openCapturePopover
members.doc: Open the capture indicator popover.

members.name: captureStop
members.doc: Stop capture on a surface.

members.name: captureFocus
members.doc: Focus the surface that is capturing.

members.name: stopDisplayShare
members.doc: Stop a screen share.

members.name: resolveDisplayPicker
members.doc: Answer the screen-share picker.

members.name: openMainMenu
members.doc: Open the platform main menu at a point (strip only). Resolves to whether a menu item was chosen.

members.name: closeOverlay
members.doc: Dismiss the overlay.

members.name: setWorkspaceSwitcherOpen
members.doc: Tell main whether the workspace popover is open, so Escape closes it first.

members.name: onOverlayEscape
members.doc: Escape was pressed while the overlay had focus.

members.name: listHistory
members.doc: List history entries, newest first.

members.name: listFavorites
members.doc: List Favorites.

members.name: listRemoteTabs
members.doc: List other devices' open tabs. Empty unless Profile Sync is on in the Personal profile.

members.name: cancelWorkspaceAction
members.doc: Cancel a pending workspace action.

members.name: listWorkspaces
members.doc: List Named Workspaces.

members.name: saveWorkspaceAs
members.doc: Save the current window as a Named Workspace.

members.name: openWorkspace
members.doc: Open a Named Workspace.

members.name: createBlankWorkspace
members.doc: Create and open an empty Named Workspace.

members.name: renameWorkspace
members.doc: Rename a Named Workspace.

members.name: removeWorkspace
members.doc: Delete a Named Workspace (undoable).

members.name: restoreWorkspace
members.doc: Undo a workspace deletion.

members.name: forgetWorkspace
members.doc: Make a workspace deletion permanent.

members.name: moveWorkspace
members.doc: Move a workspace up or down in the list.

members.name: searchSuggestions
members.doc: Fetch search suggestions when enabled in Settings.

members.name: onRemoteTabsUpdated
members.doc: Other devices' open tabs changed. Same projection as listRemoteTabs.

members.name: onWorkspacesUpdated
members.doc: Named Workspaces changed.

members.name: clearHistory
members.doc: Clear browsing history.

members.name: toggleAdblock
members.doc: Turn blocking on or off for the active tab's provider, or take the active site off the allow-list. The result includes the whole allow-list, which only trusted chrome receives.

members.name: allowAdsOnActiveSite
members.doc: Allow ads on the active site. Resolves to the allowed hostname, null when there is no tab or the page has no blockable site, or an error.

members.name: toggleDarkSiteOnActiveSite
members.doc: Darken the active site, or leave it as the site drew it (Dark websites). Resolves to the hostname and whether it is now darkened while Blanc is dark, or null when the page has no website.

members.name: siteInfoForgetCertificateException
members.doc: Stop allowing the active tab's origin past its certificate warning for this session, close that session's connections, and reload the tab. Resolves false when there was nothing to forget.

members.name: sleepBackgroundTabs
members.doc: Quiet all background tabs now. Resolves to the ids of the tabs that were quieted.

members.name: fillLoginFromOnePassword
members.doc: Fill a login from 1Password (explicit invoke only). Resolves to false when the broker is unavailable.

members.name: cycleTheme
members.doc: Set or cycle the theme (system, light, dark). Resolves to the theme now in effect.

members.name: onThemeAppearance
members.doc: The effective appearance changed.

members.name: minimizeWindow
members.doc: Minimize the window.

members.name: maximizeWindow
members.doc: Maximize or restore the window.

members.name: closeWindow
members.doc: Close the window.

members.name: onTabsUpdated
members.doc: The tab model changed; the payload is the full projection.

members.name: onPageTint
members.doc: The active page's tint changed.

members.name: onDownloadsActivity
members.doc: Download activity for the strip indicator.

members.name: acknowledgeDownloads
members.doc: Mark download activity as seen.

members.name: onOverlayShow
members.doc: Main is showing the overlay in a mode.

members.name: onOverlayHide
members.doc: Main hid the overlay.

members.name: onOverlayToggle
members.doc: Toggle the overlay panel.

members.name: onIslandState
members.doc: Island presentation state changed.

members.name: onFindResult
members.doc: Find-in-page match counts changed.
